description: A full splat inside the each expression of a full splat nests a second splat node
notes: The spec's grammar lets a full splat consume only attribute accesses and index operations (fullSplat = "[" "*" "]" (GetAttr | Index)*), so a second splat operator would start a new splat on the first splat's whole result, and the prose doesn't mention nesting. hashicorp/hcl makes everything after [*], including further splats, part of the first splat's each expression (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
